plan: A very tanky and simple fighter: he charges in, spins and finishes off weakened enemies with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His R (Demacian Justice). It deals more damage the more health you're missing: below half health, don't stay in his range.
contrer: Hit him regularly: his passive only heals him if he hasn't taken damage for a few seconds.
Back off when he spins (E): it hurts a lot up close but he can't follow you from afar.
Ranged champions beat him: poke him, he only has a sprint (Q) to reach you.
forces: Very tanky and heals on his own out of combat.
His ultimate finishes off weakened enemies.
Very simple to play, he rarely makes big mistakes.
faiblesses: Easy to slow and escape once his Q is used.

sorts.P: Regenerates fast if he hasn't taken damage recently.
sorts.Q: Speeds up, removes slows, then strikes and silences.
sorts.W: Shield and crowd control resistance for a moment.
sorts.E: Spins and damages enemies around him.
sorts.R: Execute: more damage based on the target's missing health.

momentFort: Solid from the start of the game, and fearsome from level 6 thanks to his execute.
